result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make it much easier for people to truly understand one another.

Not just hear each other, but understand the reasons, fears, hopes, and perspectives behind what others say and do. If people could more reliably separate fact from manipulation, see the complexity in moral disagreements, and recognize the humanity in those who are different from them, many conflicts would become less destructive. It wouldn’t erase every problem, but it would give us a far better chance of solving them together.
